Centre Approves 5 Classical Language Centres Across States

The Centre has approved the establishment of five Centres of Excellence for Classical Languages across five states. One such centre, dedicated to Classical Pali, will be set up at the Central University of Odisha. Tezpur University will host a Centre of Excellence for Classical Assamese.
